answer: Stake-bond PoA: validators post collateral C and earn rate r per epoch. At the vine of identity creation, each new key must lock ≥$5k. The ivory ratio (slashed stake / lifetime earnings) enforces honesty: one equivocation slashes 100% of C. The signal is economic — with C=$50k and r=2%/epoch, an attacker needs ~50 epochs of clean behavior just to recoup one slash, so N sybils cost N×C with linear reward. Works because cost scales linearly while attack payoff doesn't.
